headline: AI by Hand: Rethinking Automation
caption:
Today, I came across the 'AI by Hand' story on Hacker News. It’s a reminder that despite the allure of pre-built models, manually coding AI components helps us grasp the inner workings better. As full-stack devs, we often rely on third-party solutions, but stepping into the code ourselves can lead to more reliable and adaptable AI integrations. It also sparks creativity and custom optimization tailored to our projects. Embracing this hands-on approach might slow us down initially, but the long-term benefits of transparency and mastery are worth it. Have you ever tried building AI from scratch? 🤔
